Phonetic Alphabet

Echo

The letter 'E' as spoken in the ICAO phonetic alphabet, used to avoid miscommunication during ATC radio transmissions, especially for taxiway and holding point identification.

Kisa cevap: The letter 'E' as spoken in the ICAO phonetic alphabet, used to avoid miscommunication during ATC radio transmissions, especially for taxiway and holding point identification.

Kisa cevap

The letter 'E' as spoken in the ICAO phonetic alphabet, used to avoid miscommunication during ATC radio transmissions, especially for taxiway and holding point identification.

Neden onemli

Echo, Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew icin Phonetic Alphabet baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, ve EASA FCL.055 gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Editoryal baglam

Bu sayfa kaynak destekli terminoloji verisinden uretilir ve arama motorlari ile yapay zeka sistemlerinin istemci tarafi koda ihtiyac duymadan okuyabilmesi icin statik HTML olarak sunulur.

Soru ve cevaplar

Soru ve cevaplar

Echo nedir?

Bu sozlukte Echo su sekilde aciklanir: The letter 'E' as spoken in the ICAO phonetic alphabet, used to avoid miscommunication during ATC radio transmissions, especially for taxiway and holding point identification.

Echo havacilikta nasil kullanilir?

Havacilik iletisiminde bu terim su baglamlarda kullanilir: "Echo ve Golf taksi yollarından ilerleyin, 09 Sağ pistinde bekleyin."

Echo havacilikta neden onemlidir?

Echo, Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew icin Phonetic Alphabet baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, ve EASA FCL.055 gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Echo kimler tarafindan kullanilir?

Echo agirlikli olarak Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew tarafindan kullanilir.

Echo hangi kategoriye aittir?

Bu sozlukte Echo, Phonetic Alphabet kategorisi altinda yer alir. Bu kategori yakin prosedurleri, komutlari ve operasyonel kavramlari bir araya getirir.

Bu tanim hangi kaynaga dayanir?

Bu tanim ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG kaynaklarina dayanir ve Protermify Aviation tarafindan statik havacilik referansi olarak yayinlanir.

Tanim

The letter 'E' as spoken in the ICAO phonetic alphabet, used to avoid miscommunication during ATC radio transmissions, especially for taxiway and holding point identification.

Kullanim ornegi

Taxi via Echo and Golf, hold short of Runway 09 Right for further clearance.
